newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest share prices up in bull run.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest share prices up in bull run.

text.p: The bulk of Bucharest average share prices picked up on Tuesday in a bullish phase extended from the previous day.
"The market turned even more bullish than yesterday in rather thin supply," said a trader.

Eighteen companies gained on their average prices, 12 slipped and three remained unchanged. Six companies had no trade and two were suspended. Buying pressure persisting throughout the session led some of the stocks to higher quotes.
Turnover was 14.2 billion lei, kept close to the previous day's level by a special trade worth more than 3.5 billion lei in first-tier fertiliser maker Azomures.
Two unofficial indices, the VAB and BIG, based on average prices and market capitalisation, rose 1.5 and 1.31 percent respectively from Monday, with the BIG touching a year high.
Another independent index, CAS-SE, issued for the first time by Creditanstalt Securities on Tuesday, showed a 1.48 percent gain.
Operators expected the bullish mood to continue on Wednesday, saying many buy notes had been left in the market.
The first tier was once again the highlight of the session, with a turnover level of 8.3 billion lei.
Five of the seven listings in this section closed higher, one fell and one -- Arctic refrigerator maker -- was suspended pending negotiations on the sale of 51 percent.
Vehicle parts maker Compa gained 150 lei to close at 2,550, while fertiliser makers Sofert and Azomures ended 1,000 and 150 lei firmer at 26,500 and 3,750 lei.
The special trade involved 1.5 million Azomures shares, traded at 2,317.5 lei per share.
Antibiotice and Terapia pharmaceuticals closed 300 and 100 lei higher at 6,850 and 6,750 respectively.
Oltchim chemical plant lost three percent on its average price to 3,275 lei and also closed weaker at 3,200 lei, losing 200 lei from Monday.
Dye maker Policolor dominated the second tier with 1.5 billion lei in turnover. It closed 150 lei up at 6,300.
